name: io.github.seayniclabs/knowledge
description: Search, read and write your self-hosted Open Notebook knowledge base from an AI assistant.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWLEDGE_OPEN_NOTEBOOK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of your Open Notebook server, e.g. https://notebook.example.com

environmentVariables.name: KNOWLEDGE_OPEN_NOTEBOOK_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for your Open Notebook server, if it has one

environmentVariables.name: KNOWLEDGE_OPEN_NOTEBOOK_REQUIRE_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: true (default): you approve each new note. false: the assistant may write on its own

environmentVariables.name: KNOWLEDGE_OPEN_NOTEBOOK_ALLOWED_NOTEBOOKS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated notebook names the assistant may write to without asking
